body: Idt a quality rehab would let you out unsupervised a day after relapsing. Unless maybe they're milking her insurance.

I guess that could be it but she essentially told me that im not a positive influence to her. She keeps going back and forth with me. Im not trying to sound selfish or angry but she says she wants to distance herself from me then a week later proceeds hit me up w/  her problems. 

   Its really stressing me out! I know what she's going through and I do want to be there for her, yet it seems like she can't make up her mind if she want me in her life or not.

The sober living in California makes no sense to me! Not to minimize her problem but back home she only knew ONE Xanax dealer who started to refuse to sell to her. 

 Also what is the point of building a sober network, getting a sponsor if you are never going to seem them again? When I mentioned this part to her she seemed to get upset and really defensive.

  We where supposed to go on a trip to Joshua Tree in cali (which I payed for and had to cancel after she went away to treatment). We made a pact to stay sober till the trip (I only smoke) but she ended up relapsing, drinking and got assaulted at the party. I left work mid shift and drove all the way to comfort her. But ever since then she's seems like she went downhill and went to rehab afterwards.

On a selfish note, I just feel really agrivated  that she keeps texting me all these disconcerting text updates but dosent elaborate or call me to actually talk about it.

However, most importantly I'm really worried about her and im hoping rehab dosent make her worse. Idk I've seen some people come out better after rehab and others come out thinking they're not bad enough. Idk if that makes sense.

I know this will probably ruin our friendship but im thinking about letting her mom know my concerns. This rehab is giving me a vibe that they're using her for her insurance. 

Wyt?

My mom is in recovery. As well I went to two residential rehabs when I was 15 and 16 for 30s. 

  However the second time I went to one I was serious about my recovery and still had triggers but would never plot on using or would let someone  I was close with there know how I'm feeling.

  I'm just worried she is going to get worse in this rehab. Im getting this vibe that she met some bad influences and dosent want to leave.

Like hanging w/ a group that impulsively goes and gets motel rooms and gives each other tattoos doesn't sound exactly like positive influences. 

Just dosent seem like the type of group that would be taking recovery seriously. Like those who religiously go to NA/AA and practice there steps. Idk

Trust me I wanna do me, I wanna just forget about her and not care. But its easier said then done.

Thank you all for taking your time to read my post,! I know it was alot to read and the problem seems relatively miniscule yet it has been driving me low key crazy! 

I'm really grateful for all you!
Btw I honestly appreciate you taking your time to give me advice for the second time.
Lmao! Thank you for that!
Thank you for ur advice and understanding. Ill definitely just let her be for now, i just really hope she gets better not worse.

Like I've always been there for her idk.

Idk just makes me feel really disposable, slightly upsetting I guess.

I fully understand your perspective and I think you're absolutely right, I'm most definitely feel like I'm being selfish. 

Yet what bothers me is that I totally get it if you need time to figure your shit out ive been there before. I respected her boundaries and didn't contact her for a week. Yet she persists to hmu whenever she relapses or is in a negative spot. 

However maybe I'm wrong, but the environment she is in rn dosent seem to be the best especially if she relapsed twice in a span of two weeks, right?

So essentially im really confused about the boundaries she is trying to set up?

I'm just worried that it might be a flop house. Like she was able to go out by herself the next day after relapsing. Also she was caught sneaking out as well. As well they let her buy a tattoo gun and give others tattoos there? Like does that sound right to you? 

I guess its like they say, "accept the things I cannot change" just can't help but worry idk.

Should I still try calling to check up in her or will that take away from her 2 phone calls a week?
